title: Delete Bot
restriction: Only the bot's owner, with an MFA ticket, can delete it; a bot token gets NotFound.

title: Fetch Bot
restriction: With a bot token it returns only the bot itself (its own id), to read settings such as `privileged_intents`; another bot's id answers IsBot. The token is never in the answer.

title: Edit Bot
restriction: Only the bot's owner (user session) can edit it; a bot token gets NotFound.

title: Remove Interactions Endpoint
restriction: Only the bot's owner (user session) can call it; a bot token gets IsBot.

title: Set Interactions Endpoint
restriction: Only the bot's owner (user session) can call it; a bot token gets IsBot.

title: New Interactions Signing Secret
restriction: Only the bot's owner, with an MFA ticket, can make a signing secret; a bot token gets IsBot.

title: Fetch Owned Bots
restriction: Lists the bots a user owns; a bot token gets an empty list. Use the Developer Portal.

title: Create Bot
restriction: Bots cannot create bots: the owner's user session creates them in the Developer Portal (IsBot).

title: Gets all webhooks
restriction: Webhooks are switched on per instance: `GET /` shows `features.webhooks`. Where they are off, creating and listing answer FeatureDisabled and every `/webhooks/...` address answers 404 NotFound.

title: Creates a webhook
restriction: Webhooks are switched on per instance: `GET /` shows `features.webhooks`. Where they are off, creating and listing answer FeatureDisabled and every `/webhooks/...` address answers 404 NotFound.

title: Start Thread
restriction: The first message (content, up to 2000 characters) is sent like any message of the bot: Send Messages and the mention rules apply, and if it is refused no thread is made. It takes no embeds, components or attachments yet; send those in a second message.

title: Remove a Poll Vote
restriction: Bots cannot vote in a poll: a bot token gets IsBot.

title: Vote on a Poll
restriction: Bots cannot vote in a poll: a bot token gets IsBot.

title: Forward Message
restriction: Forwarding is switched on per instance: `GET /` shows `features.forwarding`. Where it is off the answer is FeatureDisabled.

title: Search for Messages
restriction: Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`); text search answers IsBot.

title: Search for Messages in a Server
restriction: Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`); text search answers IsBot.

title: Fetch Bans
restriction: The API returns users[].avatar as null for users without an avatar, although the OpenAPI schema says object.

title: Edit Server
restriction: Some fields can only be changed by platform staff.

title: Edit User
restriction: Some fields can only be changed by platform staff.

title: Open Direct Message
restriction: Opening a DM can work while sending into it is refused: the person's privacy settings and blocks decide (DirectMessagesRestricted, Blocked).
